claims.statement: The UK Gambling Commission's remote customer-interaction framework requires systems that embed identify, act, and evaluate as an ongoing process.
Commission Recommendation 2014/478/EU promotes high consumer protection and minimizing health and economic harm from excessive online gambling.

contrary_evidence: Large operators already maintain proprietary harm models and may refuse cross-operator benchmarking even when anonymized.

economics.acquisition_route: One-to-many distribution through player-account-management and gambling-CRM vendors serving licensed operators.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 15 operators at 45000 PLN blended monthly revenue yields 8.1 million PLN ARR by year five and can support founder equity above 5 million PLN without double-counting retained earnings.
economics.founder_time: Hypothesis: 4 founder hours daily for analytics and governance while a responsible-gambling specialist handles policy review.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65-75% gross margin after security, model monitoring, clinical-adviser review, and platform revenue share.
economics.payback: Hypothesis: a 40000 PLN platform integration pays back in 12 months after onboarding three mid-sized operators.
economics.pricing: Hypothesis, including the capital figure: 3000 PLN monthly platform minimum plus 400 PLN per controlled intervention readout.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Each triggered customer interaction and subsequent effectiveness evaluation is a repeat paid event.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Strictly purpose-limited, permissioned response labels improve intervention selection across contexts
fingerprint.customer: Licensed remote gambling operators and their compliance teams
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Embedded integration through player-account and CRM platform vendors
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Protective-intervention orchestration and evaluation API sold per event and platform minimum
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The operator pays when an intervention outcome is evaluated and recorded
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A player crosses a harm-risk threshold and an interaction must be chosen and evaluated

founder_fit: The founder understands betting behavior and experimentation, but the concept remains non-promotional, analytical, and channel-led.
risks: Behavioral data must never be repurposed for gambling promotion, and weak interventions could harm users or create regulatory liability.

structure.control_point: The closed feedback loop linking detected risk, protective action, and evaluated outcome
structure.critical_dependency: Operator deployment, regulator-aligned methods, and lawful processing of sensitive behavioral data

thesis: Embed responsible-gambling intervention experiments in player-account and CRM platforms, charging per evaluated interaction while creating a permissioned cross-operator dataset of which protective actions reduced harm signals.
title: SaferPlay Intervention Outcomes API
uncertainties: No evidence yet establishes platform access, regulator acceptance, or causal lift from pooled outcome data.
